alex: quick heads up — noticed some service-account tokens showing up in project search results in the console. they appear under "owned by" even when bound to different projects. :eyes:

maria: can you repro? which workflow?

alex: steps: create SA via API exchange -> mint token -> hit /v1/projects search in console. token card shows up. happens on prod canary and staging.

sam_k: i saw this yesterday in canary logs. frontend is using the auth-proxy "origin_project" header for attribution instead of the "effective_project" the proxy also emits. seems like a routing/policy mismatch.

denise: yep. auth-proxy exposes both X-Origin-Project and X-Effective-Project. frontend currently prefers origin. we should prefer effective for UI + billing attribution.

alex: action items i see: 1) change frontend display to use effective_project when present, 2) ensure quota/billing attribution uses the same field, 3) add telemetry flags so we can monitor regressions. plan: feature flag + canary rollout.

maria: for telemetry, propose adding metric tag `sa_visible_in_search` and a counter `sa_console_search_hits` with labels {origin_project,effective_project,principal_type}. sample at 100% for 24h after rollout, then downsample to 1%.

sam_k: for billing: current pipeline bills to token owner org which is wrong for delegated tokens. i think billing should be based on the effective_project that initiated the request. that's an auth-routing semantics debate we need to settle with finance.

denise: proposed minimal change: frontend uses `display_project = X-Effective-Project || X-Origin-Project`. backend (auth-proxy) should guarantee X-Effective-Project for delegated flows. add unit tests and an integration test that asserts attribution header precedence.

alex: quick frontend patch idea: in search result render, replace: `attr = headers['X-Origin-Project']` with `attr = headers['X-Effective-Project'] || headers['X-Origin-Project']`. add feature flag `console.sa_attribution_v2`.

sam_k: logging snippet for auth-proxy to include in PR:
```
proto: {
  origin_project: "org-12",
  effective_project: "proj-234",
  principal_type: "service_account",
  token_id: "tk_abc123"
}
```

maria: +1. also create a small dashboard tile: SA Search results by attribution + a panel for `billing_attrib_mismatch` (count when owner_org != effective_project_org).

infra-bot: deploy queued: staging at 2024-11-21T03:00Z, canary rollout 5% for 2h, then 20% if no alerts.

alex: i'll file a short RFC and attach a prototype PR. plan to enable feature flag for internal only, run 5% canary tomorrow, watch `sa_console_search_hits` and `billing_attrib_mismatch`.

denise: sounds good. ping me once PR is up, i'll review auth-proxy changes.

maria: pinging @finance for billing decision and @security for any policy concerns. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks everyone — will follow up with RFC + PR link in this thread.
